review.summary: No actionable bugs, regressions, security issues, missing-test findings, documentation gaps or scope violations were identified in the committed TASK-058 diff. Reviewed history disclosure, elapsed-time formatting, per-submission notice transitions and dismissal, organisation isolation, detail fallback, polling and cancellation guards, completion-driven comparison selection, and the developer-requested layout refinements. Frontend lint, all 261 tests and the production build including TypeScript compilation passed on the reviewed revision. Browser layout, keyboard and screen-reader verification remain developer-owned and were not confirmed by this review. The review is advisory and does not replace human approval.
